entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: After prolonged negotiations, the matter is settled.

The respondents-claimants have agreed to receive and the Respondent-Insurance Company has agreed to pay a global compensation of Rs.18,30,000/- (Rupees Eighteen Lakh Thirty Thousand only), as against Rs.19,47,500/- awarded by the Tribunal, in full and final settlement of the claim.
A joint Memo is filed on behalf of the parties to this effect.
Same is accepted.
3. The amount agreed shall be apportioned amongst the respondents/claimants in terms of the order of the Tribunal.

4. From and out of the amount apportioned to the respective claimants, 75% of the amount shall be disbursed to the said claimants and 25% shall be kept in fixed deposit in a nationalized bank of the choice of the claimants for a period of 3 years, upon the expiry of which, the deposit amount together with accrued interest shall be released directly to the claimants without any further orders in that regard.

5. The Appellant-Insurance Company has agreed to deposit the said amount before the Tribunal within six weeks from the date of preparation of Award, failing which the said amount shall carry interest at the rate of 9% p.a. from the date of default, till the date of deposit.
6. The Miscellaneous First Appeal stands disposed of in terms of the Joint Memo.
The award of the Tribunal shall stand modified accordingly.
Draw up the award accordingly.
7. Statutory amount in deposit, if any, is ordered to be transmitted to the concerned Tribunal forthwith for disbursement in terms of the order ordered hereinabove.

Sd/-
JUDGE Sd/-
